audit.why: The prose addresses the owner in second person, so third-person pronouns refer to the enemy. These templates were authored for a male enemy and only the champion name was substituted, leaving the pronouns wrong. champ-data/champ-gender.js is the authority.

edits.before: Leona out-engages you at levels 1-5 — his E dash-root is a longer, faster lock than your walk-up dismount, so if he lands it on your ADC you're stunned before you can W-slam. Respect his E range, hug your ADC, and don't facecheck brush where a Zenith Blade is waiting. Ward defensively and let him whiff a dash before you ever consider counter-engaging.

edits.before: Through levels 3-5 Leona keeps the initiation edge with his front-loaded CC chain, so play reactive: bait his E, then punish the cooldown. Your W stun is your counter-engage tool, not your opener here. The lane swings at 6 when your Magnet Storm gives you a teamfight answer his single-target ult lacks.
